name: Knock Out -Taisen Gata Datsui Mahjong-
source:
Train yourself by playing mahjong with teachers and move on to defeat girls in strip mahjong.

Based on characters from a "Shijou Saikyou no Deshi Ken'ichi" manga, which was later adapted to  [url=https://anidb.net/anime/4596]anime[/url].
[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
和老师一起打麻将来训练自己，然后在脱衣麻将中击败女孩。

基于《四条西京的弟子研一》漫画中的人物，后来改编为[url=https://anidb.net/anime/4596]动漫[/url]。
